_id: att rung: attitudeJointSearchReceiveEndMultipath. att011 (joint rigid-body integer/attitude search, space-grade FOG gyro, star tracker OFF) PLUS receive-end carrier multipath: reflections off the SPACECRAFT STRUCTURE, truth-only, per antenna. One toggle against att011.
_delta: errors.multipath.receiveEnd.enable: false -> true. Nothing else. Magnitude and correlation time are masterConfig's declared defaults, not set here.
_whyTHISRUNGEXISTS: att010 and att011 quote attitude figures under an error model with a hole in exactly the place that matters. Only ANTENNA-SPECIFIC errors survive an inter-antenna single difference, which is the observable this whole ladder is built on. A term common to the four phase centres cancels identically and cannot touch the answer. Before this rung, EVERY carrier error in the simulation was either common to the antennas or absent, so the att figures were bounded by nothing on the axis that actually limits real GNSS attitude systems.
_ITWASNOTATOGGLE_ITHADTOBEIMPLEMENTED: errors.multipath.coloredGM.carrierScale = 0.01 was declared in masterConfig and READ BY NOTHING -- a genuinely inert leaf, of the same family as the ~70 inert toggles already on record here. Carrier multipath did not exist in this simulation: there is no multipath term anywhere in CarrierMeasurementBuilder. This rung ships the implementation: ErrorChain.receiveEndCarrierMultipath, a per-(tower,antenna,signal) Gauss-Markov chain on its own RNG stream (RngSource.MP_RX_CARRIER = 30, previously unused, so no existing stream shifts), added to z_phi ONLY and never to h_phi.
_whyNOTJUSTFLIPsharedAcrossAntennas: Because that would be wrong physics, not a shortcut. coloredGM is parameterised as the classical GROUND-STATION model: 0.30 m steady state with a 1/sin(el) envelope keyed on TOWER elevation, i.e. the ground bounce at the transmit end. That term genuinely IS common to all four receive antennas, which is precisely why golden_baseline.json sets its sharedAcrossAntennas gate true, having measured that drawing it per-antenna handed a 4-antenna run a free factor sqrt(4). Flipping that gate would make the ground bounce falsely antenna-specific. The same file declares the real gap in writing: 'the RECEIVE-end component -- reflections off the spacecraft structure, which genuinely does differ per antenna -- is not separately modelled.' This rung models it, as a SEPARATE term, leaving the transmit-end treatment untouched.
_whyITSURVIVESBOTHDIFFERENCES: Keyed per (tower, ANTENNA, signal). It survives the inter-antenna single difference because it differs per antenna, and it survives the between-tower double difference because the tower's direction in the BODY frame differs per tower, so the reflection geometry off the structure differs too. It is therefore the one error source that reaches the integer-fixed attitude rows unopposed, which is exactly why it is the right thing to add next and why its absence made the earlier rungs optimistic.
_MAGNITUDEandWHEREITSITSINTHELITERATURE: 3 mm steady-state 1-sigma, which is coloredGM's OWN declared carrierScale (0.01) applied to its own 0.30 m code figure -- the repo's 1/100 code-to-carrier rule rather than an invented number. This is the OPTIMISTIC end. Kaplan's benign-environment carrier multipath is 2 cm, about 6x larger, and lambda/4 = 47.6 mm at L1 is the hard physical bound a reflected ray cannot exceed. So a null result here does NOT license 'multipath does not matter': it licenses 'multipath at the repo's own 1/100 scale does not matter', and the Kaplan-benign case is a separate rung worth cutting.
_QUASISTATICandWHYTHATISTHESHARPPART: tau_s = 300 s against a 3600 s arc, so this behaves less like noise and more like a slowly drifting per-(tower,antenna) phase OFFSET. That is the dangerous shape for this family. A perfectly CONSTANT offset would be partly absorbed by the float ambiguity and would look harmless. A DRIFTING one is exactly what an integer fix cannot absorb, what the double difference cannot cancel, and what a covariance built from white carrier sigma does not charge. The att ladder's central mechanism assumes the inter-antenna bias is constant and cancels; this term is the counterexample to that assumption.
_whatEACHOUTCOMEMEANS: If the attitude error degrades materially from att011's 0.182352 deg, then the 0.182 figure was an artefact of the missing error and this rung supplies the defensible bound the family previously lacked. If it barely moves, 3 mm of quasi-static per-antenna multipath is genuinely below the DD noise floor of ~19 mm and the earlier figures survive at THIS multipath level, with the Kaplan-benign rung still owed. Either way the rung converts an unbounded claim into a bounded one.
_THERESULT: MEASURED 3600 s: finalAttitudeError_deg 2.52298143, finalAttitudeSigma_deg 0.19944731, err/sigma 12.65. Against att011's 0.18235218 / 0.20798347 / 0.877 that is 13.8x WORSE on error while the sigma does not move at all, so the covariance goes from honest to lying by a factor of 12.7. Worse than that: 2.523 deg is ABOVE the 1.500 deg initial attitude error, i.e. an improvement ratio of 0.595, meaning the filter ended further from truth than the prior it started with. The carrier rows became actively harmful. Liveness held throughout: jointRigidBodyFixed, rms 0.079642 cycles against the 0.169461 gate, one distinct integer set over 729 candidates, 12 DD rows, 0 rejected.
_THETELLISTHATTHERESIDUALDOESNOTMOVE: diffAttResidRMS_m 0.019891 against att011's 0.019107, only 1.041x, while the attitude error went up 13.8x. That is the signature of a systematic the geometry maps into a weakly observable state: it is nearly invisible in the residual RMS and fatal to the estimate. NO RESIDUAL MONITOR WOULD HAVE CAUGHT THIS, and neither would a NIS check on these rows, which is why the rung had to be run rather than argued.
_THEINTEGERFIXREMOVEDTHEABSORBERandTHATI: Established by adversarial review of the row construction, and it is stronger than 'multipath hurts'. On the FLOAT rungs (att004-att009) delta_B is a free REAL constant per (tower, baseline), and it absorbs an antenna-specific quasi-static offset almost entirely. Once the joint fix is accepted, DiffAttitudeBuilder builds dz = (z_t - z_p) - lambda*(N_t - N_p) against dh = g_t - g_p, i.e. PURE GEOMETRY, and the Jacobian fills ONLY sm.euler_idx -- there is no ambiguity column, no bias column and no clock column left in those rows. So the mechanism that buys the accuracy in att010/att011 is the SAME mechanism that removes the only thing that was soaking up antenna-specific systematics. The fix makes the solution more accurate under a clean error model and more fragile under a realistic one. This also DISPOSES of the objection that the result is an artefact of an undefended tau: a perfectly STATIC offset is no more absorbable than a drifting one on this path, so the effect does not vanish in the tau -> infinity limit.
_THEZEROSTARTARTEFACTWASMEASUREDandITWAS: The first implementation started the Gauss-Markov chain at zero, so the term was at only 0.574 of steady-state amplitude at the one-shot search epoch (t ~ 60 s, tau 300 s) and grew afterwards, which would have overstated the damage by fixing the integer during an artificially quiet interval. That run gave 2.62847929 deg. Initialising from the stationary distribution x0 ~ N(0, sigma_ss) gives 2.52298143 deg. The artefact was worth 4.0 percent. The effect is robust to it, and the number quoted here is the stationary one.
_FOURIMPLEMENTATIONDEFECTSFOUNDBYREVIEWA: (1) Zero start instead of the stationary distribution, above. (2) The term ignored errors.multipath.truth.enable, so any multipath-ablation arm declaring multipath OFF would still have injected the only multipath that reaches attitude -- the inert/mis-declared-toggle failure this repo has on record. It now honours the master gate and returns exactly 0. (3) Under legacy shared-RNG mode it drew from obj.mpRng, which belongs to the TRANSMIT-end multipath, so enabling this term would silently have shifted a different error source; it now ERRORS rather than either corrupting its neighbour or silently no-opping. (4) No lambda/4 clamp and no band coupling, so an unbounded Gaussian in metres could emit values no reflected ray can produce, and the term was BAND-BLIND -- a defect already on record here for the carrier path. Clamped at lambda/4 = 47.6 mm at L1, which is what couples the metre-valued sigma to the band. Not binding at 3 mm (max draw 7.55 mm) but it will bind at Kaplan scale.
_TWOKNOWNLIMITSNOTFIXED: (a) The GM chain steps only when the link is called, i.e. only above the elevation mask, so across a visibility gap it FREEZES rather than decaying toward zero. Immaterial here -- all 5 towers are visible for the whole GEO arc (mean visible towers 5.0) -- but wrong for any scenario with rising and setting links. (b) The injected value is added to z_phi and discarded: no cpInfo field, no datastore field, nothing in the saved .mat can show the leaf did anything. Liveness was verified with a standalone harness (per-antenna rms 2.7-4.3 mm against the 3.0 mm target, inter-antenna SD 2.11 mm, between-tower DD 4.42 mm, lag-1 autocorrelation 0.973, exactly 0 with the leaf off) rather than from the run itself.
_whatITDOESNOTFIX: The DD measurement covariance is still assembled with blkdiag across (baseline,signal) groups, dropping the shared reference-antenna correlation, so the SIGMA remains not defensible in absolute terms in every rung of this family. And this rung ADDS a truth-side error the filter does not model, which will push err/sigma UP: read a rising err/sigma here as the covariance correctly failing to account for an unmodelled systematic, not as a regression.
